strengths_deep_dive: The Noor Project maintains basic functional operations on the ground in Pakistan, operating a free grammar school, a medical clinic, and vocational training facilities to serve low-income families <cite id="1">Charity Navigator metadata</cite>. Financially, the organization shows operational stability in its reserves, holding 3.4 months of working capital <cite id="3">Form 990 (2023)</cite>. The organization has also expanded its fundraising reach, growing total annual revenue to <cite id="3">$1,759,964 in FY2023</cite> with a strong 3-year CAGR of 29.6%.
rich_narrative.summary: The Noor Project works to lift marginalized families out of poverty in Pakistan by operating a free grammar school, a free health clinic, and vocational training centers <cite id="1">Charity Navigator metadata</cite>. However, severe transparency and reporting gaps present major concerns for potential donors. No financial filings newer than FY2023 are available — donors should treat this 3-year-old financial picture with caution <cite id="3">Form 990 (2023)</cite>. The organization reported <cite id="3">$1,759,964 in total revenue for FY2023</cite>, achieving a 3-year revenue CAGR of 29.6%. Despite this top-line revenue growth, crucial operational details are missing. The program expense ratio is completely unknown, meaning it is impossible to determine how much money directly reaches charitable programs versus overhead expenses <cite id="3">Form 990 (2023)</cite>. Furthermore, governance structures are severely deficient with unknown board members and 0 out of 4 standard IRS policy filings reported <cite id="3">Form 990 (2023)</cite>. The organization is rated as sadaqah-eligible for general charitable giving <cite id="2">Charity Website - Zakat</cite>.
